resources.string: After CarPlay connects, try to disconnect Bluetooth media from the same phone while keeping calls and pairing. Applies immediately to the current session.
If playback pauses automatically, check the result and how to turn off Bluetooth media manually.

Latest check: %1$s

Receiving music from the same phone over both Bluetooth and CarPlay may cause competing media sources. Automatic handling targets only the phone identified for this wireless connection. Calls and pairing are preserved.

If the firmware prevents automatic handling, open the phone details in the vehicle Bluetooth settings. Turn off Media audio / Bluetooth music while keeping Call audio enabled, then return to CarPlay and play again. If there is no separate switch, record the logs and firmware version.

If the target phone cannot be identified over USB, handle this manually. Hearing a test tone does not confirm that phone playback and Bluetooth audio focus are coordinated.
